cause: Later .fullscreenTop button has same specificity as .toggle button and applies width/height42px and font-size15px to both nested text controls. Padding remains12px per side, leaving roughly16px content width, explaining English clipping/wrapping and Chinese vertical wrapping.
minimumCorrection: Change square-button selector to .fullscreenControls > button (direct close only). Scope white-space:nowrap to .fullscreenControls > .toggle > button if used; no global toggle/style redesign.
assertion: In each of existing12 fullscreen precision cases, assert all3 buttons visible with nonempty positive text-range rectangles fully within button bounds, and buttons contained in header/viewport. Cover both Chart and Data table selected states without dropping existing tick/cursor/date-gap assertions. Current screenshot failures are the red evidence; compare actual corrected images and preserve old artifacts separately.
controls: No source/test/capture or published mutations by advisor; all existing #1249 refusal/release effects remain scoped to their original action/branch.
